hebrewText: יָפִ֣יחַ אֱ֭מוּנָה יַגִּ֣יד צֶ֑דֶק וְ/עֵ֖ד שְׁקָרִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה

tokens.bdb: to puff, i.e. blow with the breath or air; hence, to fan (as a breeze), to utter, to kindle (a fire), to scoff
tokens.kjv: blow (upon), break, puff, bring into a snare, speak, utter.

tokens.bdb: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity
tokens.kjv: faith(-ful, -ly, -ness, (man)), set office, stability, steady, truly, truth, verily.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity
tokens.enLiteralWord: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity
tokens.explanation: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity
tokens.explanationEn: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity

tokens.bdb: properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise
tokens.kjv: bewray, [idiom] certainly, certify, declare(-ing), denounce, expound, [idiom] fully, messenger, plainly, profess, rehearse, report, shew (forth), speak, [idiom] surely, tell, utter.
tokens.explanation: nagad — anunciar, declarar, dizer, contar, revelar

tokens.bdb: the right (natural, moral or legal); also (abstractly) equity or (figuratively) prosperity
tokens.kjv: [idiom] even, ([idiom] that which is altogether) just(-ice), (un-)right(-eous) (cause, -ly, -ness).

tokens.bdb: concretely, a witness; abstractly, testimony; specifically, a recorder, i.e. prince
an untruth; by implication, a sham (often adverbial)
tokens.kjv: without a cause, deceit(-ful), false(-hood, -ly), feignedly, liar, [phrase] lie, lying, vain (thing), wrongfully.
craft, deceit(-ful, -fully), false, feigned, guile, subtilly, treachery.
